title: An actor is who a registered key says it is
note: qta_agent.principals (attestations, the key registry, authenticate), its use by the authority store's load, catch-up and restore and by the independent reader, and the Ed25519 primitive's refusals. Every attack in the suite first passes the hash chain, so each kill is the signature's.

mutations.name: AA1_a_missing_attestation_passes
mutations.rationale: an event nobody attested is accepted for a principal required to sign

mutations.name: AA2_an_actor_with_no_key_passes
mutations.rationale: an actor the registry does not know is taken at its name

mutations.name: AA3_an_unregistered_key_is_believed
mutations.rationale: a key nobody registered is looked up as though it were

mutations.name: AA4_any_registered_key_speaks_for_anyone
mutations.rationale: actor substitution and a wrong key: bob's key vouches for alice's event

mutations.name: AA5_the_signature_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a tampered signature or payload passes on the key id alone

mutations.name: AA6_no_domain_separation
mutations.rationale: a signature made for another purpose over the same hash attests the event

mutations.name: AA7_a_production_registry_takes_test_keys
mutations.rationale: a key whose secret anyone can derive from a name is accepted in production

mutations.name: AA8_key_ids_are_chosen
mutations.rationale: a registry may name one key with another's id

mutations.rationale: the actor of a signed append is a parameter again
